description: This header file declares functions and constants related to download utilities, including HTTP file downloads, OAuth, and curl initialization/termination. It also references external headers like 'urlHelper.h'.

methods.name: doHttpFileDownload
methods.description: Performs an HTTP file download, optionally handling TLS/mtls authentication.

methods.name: doAuthHttpFileDownload
methods.description: Performs an OAuth-authenticated HTTP file download.

methods.name: doCurlInit
methods.description: Initializes a CURL handle for network operations.

methods.name: doInteruptDwnl
methods.description: Interrupts a download, possibly for cancellation or pausing.

methods.name: doGetDwnlBytes
methods.description: Retrieves the number of bytes downloaded so far.

methods.name: setForceStop
methods.description: Sets a flag to force stop ongoing operations.

methods.name: doCurlPutRequest
methods.description: Performs a HTTP PUT request using CURL.
